items.title: Ukraine war latest: Russia strikes 3 Kyiv bridges in massive aerial assault on Ukraine, at least 9 dead
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 20: 3 Kyiv bridges struck in massive Russian aerial assault on Ukraine, at least 9 dead 2 Russian Kh-101 missiles, drone, fall in Poland during Russian attack on Ukraine Ukraine deploys experimental laser air defense system in Kyiv At least 1,144 children killed or injured

items.title: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over alleged assassination plot on Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner
items.teaser: The expulsion follows the disclosure of an alleged plot by Russian intelligence services to assassinate Ukrainian rapper Albert Vasiliev, known professionally as Kyivstoner, ahead of a scheduled concert in Denmark on Sept. 25.

items.title: NABU and SAPO facing media attack, Kryvonos says
items.teaser: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor’s Office (SAPO) are facing a “media attack” aimed at shifting the focus from corruption investigations to conspiracy theories.

items.title: EU sports chief lambasts FIFA, International Olympic Committee, as 'main architects that support the Kremlin'
items.teaser: Regarding the new restrictions, four EU and national officials have told the Kyiv Independent that the European Commission is expected to unveil its 22nd sanctions package on Nov. 23, with measures related to sport expected to feature prominently.

items.title: Russians attack outskirts of Kharkiv, injuring two people
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a drone attack on the outskirts of Kharkiv on the evening of 20 November.

items.title: Did the Court Change its Approach to Defining or Proving Genocidal Intent in Gambia v. Myanmar and Did it Get it Right? Part I
items.teaser: As I explained in my quick-reaction post, the principal disagreement among the judges of the ICJ in Gambia v. Myanmar (GvM) – on which the Court split 9 to 6 – related to proving the existence of genocidal intent. Some of that disagreement was on matters of principle; some of it was on the application […]

items.title: Zelensky's party lawmaker sentenced to over 3 years in jail in bribery case
items.teaser: Serhiy Kuzminykh is the fourth lawmaker from President Volodymyr Zelensky's Servant of the People parliamentary faction to receive a prison sentence.

items.title: Russian attacks cause UAH 6 bln in damage to Kharkiv aircraft plant, Director says
items.teaser: Damage to the Kharkiv State Aircraft Manufacturing Company (KSAMC) caused by Russian shelling has reached UAH 6 billion.

items.title: Mehr als drei Dutzend UN-Mitgliedstaaten verurteilen Angriffe auf Ukraine und Verletzung polnischen Luftraums
items.teaser: Mehr als drei Dutzend UN-Mitgliedstaaten, vorwiegend aus der Europäischen Union, haben die russischen Angriffe auf Kyjiw und andere ukrainische Städte am 19. und 20. November, die zivile Opfer und Schäden an der Energieinfrastruktur zur Folge hatten, scharf verurteilt.

items.title: Warum Ukrainer den Howerla besteigen
items.teaser: Jährlich besteigen zahlreiche Ukrainer den Howerla, den höchsten Berg des Landes. Auch jetzt im Krieg ist er für viele ein Ort der Selbstvergewisserung und der Kraft.

items.title: Estonia summons Russian chargé d’affaires over attacks on Ukraine
items.teaser: On November 20, Estonia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Russia’s chargé d’affaires to protest Russian missile and drone attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: Zelenskyy responds to Trump calling Putin his friend: "For us, he is an enemy and a killer"
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has responded to his US counterpart Donald Trump calling Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin his "friend".

items.title: Sachsen-Anhalt - AfD kontrolliert jetzt den Verfassungsschutz
items.teaser: Eine als rechtsextrem eingestufte Partei stellt die Hälfte des Kontrollgremiums.

items.title: Moldova reports second drone incursion into its airspace in one day
items.teaser: An unauthorized drone flight into Moldova’s airspace was recorded twice on November 20.

items.title: Why a Donbas-for-NATO deal won’t work
items.teaser: Could Ukraine give up Donbas in exchange for NATO membership? President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the U.S. negotiators had floated the idea during the recent peace talks in Abu Dhabi, raising questions about the credibility of NATO’s security guarantees and the prospects for ending Russia’s war under such conditions

items.title: Russen attackierten Region Dnipropetrowsk am Freitag fast 20 Mal, es gibt Tote und Verletzte
items.teaser: Russische Besatzer attackierten im Laufe des Tages vier Bezirke der Region Dnipropetrowsk fast 20 Mal. Dabei wurde eine Person getötet und eine weitere verletzt.

items.title: One killed and another injured in Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched almost 20 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, killing one person and injuring another.

items.title: France calls for renewed debate on Ukraine's NATO membership – source
items.teaser: France is once again raising the issue of Ukraine's NATO membership amid an acceleration of negotiations to end the war and the need to define long-term security guarantees for Ukraine and Europe.

items.title: Trump administration wants Ukraine and Russia to reach peace deal by January 2027
items.teaser: The Trump administration has told European and Ukrainian officials that it wants Ukraine and Russia to reach a peace agreement by the beginning of January 2027.

items.title: Crimean Bridge attack: Dutch journalist says Russia-24 distorted his words
items.teaser: Russia's state propaganda channel Russia-24 used footage from a broadcast by Dutch radio station BNR, distorting the words of its correspondent, Geert Jan Hahn, in a report about the Crimean Bridge.

items.title: Germany backs new drone factory plan by SkyFall and Auterion
items.teaser: The venture would expand Ukrainian weapons production abroad, adding capacity away from Russia’s attacks on Ukraine while giving Germany a potential domestic supplier of systems developed through front-line experience, Auterion announced on Nov. 20.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Russian attack 'one of largest,' Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy said Russia launched one of the largest aerial attacks since the invasion began. Poland accused Moscow of a "provocation," saying two missiles landed in the NATO country. Follow DW.

items.title: Trump claims Putin sent drones and ‘little missiles’ into Poland by mistake
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has claimed that Russian drones and missiles enter Polish territory "by mistake."

items.title: Ukrainian PM was in Poland when Russian missiles violated Polish airspace
items.teaser: A Polish media outlet has learned that Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi was at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport when Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone violated Polish airspace.

items.title: At least 1,144 children killed or injured in Ukraine during Russia's war this year, UNICEF says
items.teaser: In October alone, child casualties rose by 150% compared with the same month last year, reaching at least 146, UNICEF said.

items.title: Company with foreign investment in Brovary near Kyiv hit by Russian strike
items.teaser: VBH Ukraine, a company with foreign investment that supplies window and door fittings, has been hit by a Russian strike on the town of Brovary, near Kyiv.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia rises to ten
items.teaser: The number of people injured in Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district has risen to ten.

items.title: EU genehmigt noch eine Milliarde Euro Militärhilfe für Ukraine
items.teaser: Der Rat der Europäischen Union hat zwei Beschlüsse gefasst, die die Bereitstellung neuer Militärhilfe in Höhe von 1 Milliarde Euro für die ukrainischen Streitkräfte im Rahmen des Europäischen Friedensfonds (EPF) durch gemeinsame Beschaffung von tödlicher und nichttödlicher Ausrüstung ermöglichen.

items.title: Merz: Unterstützung der Ukraine bringt uns Dividende
items.teaser: Seit dem Angriff Russlands unterstützt Deutschland die Ukraine - insgesamt mit mehr als 100 Milliarden Euro. Ausgaben, die sich auszahlen könnten. Kanzler Merz sieht - trotz des Krieges - positive Effekte für die deutsche Wirtschaft.

items.title: Polen wirft Russland gezielte Provokation vor
items.teaser: Mehrere Flugkörper sind in den polnischen Luftraum eingedrungen - nach Einschätzung der Regierung eine gezielte Provokation Russlands. Sie könnte in Zusammenhang mit einer Übung der Ukraine-Unterstützer stehen, die derzeit in Polen stattfindet.

items.title: Poland asks NATO allies to help strengthen its air defences
items.teaser: Poland's defence minister has called on NATO allies to provide additional F-35 fighter jets, AWACS aircraft and other resources after Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

items.title: Three occupation "officials" from Donetsk served with notices of suspicion for deporting 55 Ukrainian children
items.teaser: A former "official" of the so-called "Donetsk People's Republic" and her two accomplices have been served with notices of suspicion in absentia by Ukrainian law enforcement officers. Investigators have established that they organised the deportation of 55 Ukrainian children from temporarily occupied Donetsk Oblast to R

items.title: EU approves another EUR 1B in military aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: The Council of the European Union has adopted two decisions allowing the provision of EUR 1 billion in additional military assistance to the Ukrainian Armed Forces through joint procurement of lethal and non-lethal equipment under the European Peace Facility (EPF).

items.title: EU allocates €1bn from European Peace Facility for military equipment for Ukraine
items.teaser: The EU has approved €1 billion from the European Peace Facility to supply Ukraine with drones, air defence equipment, ammunition and other military equipment by the end of 2027.

items.title: EU greenlights 1 billion euros in military support for Ukraine as top diplomat says Russia rejects peace
items.teaser: "If Moscow wants peace, its actions tell a different story... Ukraine can count on Europe to strengthen its hand on the battlefield and at the negotiating table," the EU's top diplomat Kaja Kallas said.

items.title: At least 1,144 children killed or injured in Ukraine in first ten months of 2026 – UNICEF
items.teaser: The number of children killed or injured in Ukraine as a result of the war in 2026 has already exceeded last year's figure and could approach the 2022 level by the end of the year.

items.title: 'Responsibility lies with Russian aggressor' — Austria pushes back against Moscow's claims over damage to embassy in Kyiv
items.teaser: The Russian Embassy alleged Moscow had repeatedly warned foreign nationals, including diplomatic staff, about the dangers of remaining in or traveling to Ukraine, adding that "full responsibility for any potential negative consequences lies entirely with the Austrian side."

items.title: Angriff auf Saporischschja: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf zehn
items.teaser: Nach feindlichem Beschuss im Rayon Kosmitschnyj in Saporischschja ist die Zahl der Verletzten auf zehn gestiegen.

items.title: Russian guided bomb strikes near apartment building in Zaporizhzhia, injuring four
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia with guided aerial bombs. One of the bombs landed near an apartment building, injuring four people.

items.title: French official denies that Trump demanded halt in military support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Following Donald Trump's 19 November phone call with European leaders after the Shenzhen summit, a French presidential source has denied that Trump asked the allies to restrict or end military support for Ukraine.

items.title: Raketeneinschlag: NATO-Generalsekretär sagt Polen Unterstützung zu
items.teaser: Die Ukraine wurde in der Nacht erneut heftig von Russland attackiert. Dabei wurde auch Polen getroffen, wie die Regierung in Warschau mitteilte. Die NATO steht ihrem Mitglied zur Seite.

items.title: Estonia to close road borders with Russia in response to 'sustained aggression' against Europe
items.teaser: The range of methods used by Russia to threaten European security is leading some in Europe to say "hybrid" is no longer an appropriate term for Moscow's increasingly aggressive stance.

items.title: Russia strikes emergency hospital in Kharkiv, damaging MRI scan room – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked an emergency hospital in Kharkiv. A Russian drone has struck a room housing an MRI scanner. The scanner appears to have remained intact, but specialists will assess whether it is still functioning properly.

items.title: EU and UK pledge continued joint support for Ukraine
items.teaser: The European Union and the United Kingdom have pledged to continue supporting Ukraine in its fight against Russian aggression and to maintain pressure on Russia to achieve a just and lasting peace.

items.title: Ukraine’s drone war grew through October. Units log more than 2 million verified hits this year, with the peak month so far almost 2.5 times January
items.teaser: The drones also reach further behind the front: in September, hits more than 20 km back passed 11,000 for the first time, the Defense Ministry says.

items.title: Orlen expands Ukraine gas business with new Naftogaz deal
items.teaser: The deliveries will help Ukraine meet higher gas demand during winter and diversify its supplies as Russian attacks continue to threaten the country's energy infrastructure.

items.title: France welcomes Putin's invitation to Moscow: "We have never cut ties with Russia"
items.teaser: The Élysée Palace has welcomed Putin's invitation to formalise dialogue in Moscow, while insisting Europeans must participate fully in upcoming talks with the US and Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike 3 Russian ballistic missile launchers, air defense gun-missile system, Kyiv says
items.teaser: One launcher was destroyed, while the damage to the other two is still being assessed, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Ukrainische Verteidigungskräfte treffen russisches Luftverteidigungssystem in Region Brjansk und Drohnensteuerpunkt in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 19. und in der Nacht zum 20. November griffen die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte mehrere russische Militärobjekte auf russischem Territorium sowie in den Regionen Donezk, Luhansk und Saporischschja an.

items.title: Ukraine seeks to deepen rail modernization cooperation with Deutsche Bahn – Koretskyi
items.teaser: Ukraine is seeking to deepen its strategic partnership with Germany's Deutsche Bahn, particularly in the development of standard-gauge rail lines, infrastructure modernization, and upgrades to locomotives, rolling stock and railway stations.

items.title: Merz identifies obstacles to deeper defense cooperation with Ukraine
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has called for better conditions for joint defense production with Ukraine, identifying export duties and legal restrictions on transferring intellectual property rights as obstacles to the development of joint technologies.

items.title: 'It was simply my turn' — Buryat activist brushes off prison sentence for research on Russian losses
items.teaser: A U.S.-based researcher and Buryat activist sentenced to prison in absentia by Russia for her work on Moscow's military recruitment and losses has brushed off the case against her, saying it was "simply my turn." Maria Vyushkova, 45, received the six-year sentence on Nov.

items.title: Deutsch-ukrainisches Wirtschaftsforum
items.teaser: Deutsch-ukrainisches Wirtschaftsforum in Berlin u.a. mit einer Rede von Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz (CDU)

items.title: Milfey confectionery workshop destroyed in Russian attack on Kyiv
items.teaser: Confectionery manufacturer Milfey has said its Kyiv production site suffered heavy damage after overnight Russian attacks on 19-20 November and posted a video showing the devastating effects of the fire.

items.title: Merz names two conditions for continued financial support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Continued reforms in the areas of the rule of law and the fight against corruption are prerequisites for further financial assistance to Ukraine, attracting investment and maintaining long-term support from Germany.

items.title: Russian missile hits house in Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast but fails to explode – photos
items.teaser: On the morning of 20 November, during a large-scale Russian attack on Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast, a missile struck a house in the Burshtyn hromada. Two people were rescued from the house. A hromada is an administrative unit designating a village, several villages, or a town, and their adjacent territories.

items.title: Kombinierter Raketen- und Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw: Zahl der Toten auf sieben, der Verletzten auf 17 gestiegen
items.teaser: In Kyjiw ist die Zahl der Toten infolge des russischen Raketen- und Drohnenangriffs auf sieben gestiegen, 17 Menschen wurden verletzt, teilte Kyjiwer Bürgermeister Vitali Klitschko bei Telegram mit.

items.title: Ukraine plans to launch EUR 3B war risk insurance fund in January – Koretskyi
items.teaser: Ukraine plans to launch a war risk insurance fund capitalized at EUR 3 billion with international partners in January 2027 to protect investments against war-related risks.

items.title: Ukraine says five European countries plus the EU and NATO will join talks on Russia’s war—overnight, Russia launches over 400 drones and over 110 missiles at Ukraine
items.teaser: The day Ukraine and its allies asked Russia for a winter energy ceasefire, Putin ruled it out, and that night Russia launched what Zelenskyy called one of its most massive attacks.

items.title: Denmark says Russia planned to assassinate Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner
items.teaser: Following an earlier foiled plot in Poland, Danish police arrested two suspects with weapons in Hellerup who had allegedly been hired by the Russian secret services to kill rapper Kyivstoner ahead of a concert, which was then cancelled.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit Russian air defense system in Bryansk region, drone command post in Donetsk region
items.teaser: On November 19 and overnight into November 20, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a number of Russian military facilities inside Russia and in the Donetsk, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia regions.

items.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Kyiv rises to seven, 17 injured
items.teaser: The death toll from Russia's attack on Kyiv has risen to seven, with 17 people injured.

items.title: Child casualties from war in Ukraine reach highest level in almost four years – UNICEF
items.teaser: UNICEF has reported that 114 children were killed and 1,030 injured in Ukraine between January and October 2026 – the highest child casualty figures in almost four years.

items.title: France calls for UN Security Council meeting over Russian strikes on Kyiv and embassies
items.teaser: France is calling for a meeting of the UN Security Council following a series of Russian strikes on Ukraine that killed civilians in Kyiv and damaged the diplomatic missions of Austria and the Netherlands.

items.title: Pax Shenzhen: Viel Rhetorik, wenig Substanz
items.teaser: Das Treffen der drei Atommächte brachte keine neuen Lösungsansätze für die Konflikte im Iran oder in der Ukraine. Trotz einer gemeinsamen Friedenserklärung konnten keine bedeutenden Fortschritte erzielt werden.

items.title: What’s inside the missiles hitting Ukraine’s cities? Kyiv’s count shows how sanctions still leak
items.teaser: A single Russian Iskander-M missile holds more than 147 foreign parts, with makers in at least eight countries, Ukraine's foreign minister says. He urges EU countries to bar alumina exports to Russia.

items.title: Reforming Section 301: What Are the "Unfair Trade Practices" that Should Be Targeted?
items.teaser: At some point in the coming months and years, I'm hoping for a discussion by Congress on how to reform Section 301. The focus of this conversation may be on issues such as how to give Congress greater oversight of any tariffs that are imposed, but I don't think the scope has to be limited to that.
items.source: Int. Economic Law and Policy Blog

items.title: EU disburses EUR 7.9 bln to strengthen Ukraine’s financial stability
items.teaser: On November 20, the European Commission disbursed €7.9 billion to Ukraine to support the country’s financial needs and the functioning of its public administration. This is the largest single disbursement under the Ukraine Facility.

items.title: Nach Absturz eines Flugobjekts in Polen: Ukraine arbeitet mit Polen bei Untersuchung des Vorfalls- Sybiha
items.teaser: Die Ukraine arbeitet eng mit Polen zusammen, um bei der Untersuchung von Verletzung dessen Luftraums während eines massiven russischen Angriffs zu helfen.

items.title: Russian forces maneuver under cover of fog in Huliaipole sector – Air Assault Forces
items.teaser: In the Huliaipole sector, Russian invading forces are carrying out maneuvers using cars and motorcycles under cover of fog.

items.title: 160+ Starlinks for Russian troops got onto Ukraine’s whitelist in Ukrainians’ names—Ukraine has detained the two men suspected of registering them
items.teaser: Ukraine's security service says it has now blocked more than 160 Starlink terminals that two men registered for Russian forces. items.title: NATO fully recognizes new war domains: Cyber and electromagnetic – NSATU Commander
items.teaser: Modern warfare has moved beyond traditional domains. NATO’s Security Assistance and Training for Ukraine (NSATU) mission is therefore integrating electronic warfare and cyber defense training and equipment provision at all levels, from recruits to corps headquarters.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit a Pantsir defence system that protected Russian sites in Bryansk Oblast
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces have conducted strikes against a number of military assets in Russia and in temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine on 19 November and overnight on 19-20 November.

items.title: Finnish president says US removed Ukraine section from Trump-Xi-Putin peace declaration
items.teaser: Finnish President Alexander Stubb has revealed that an initial draft of the Shenzhen declaration included a paragraph on Ukraine before the US had it cut, and spoke about Trump's phone call to Coalition of the Willing members in Berlin.

items.title: Ukraine strikes three Russian ballistic missile launchers overnight – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has reported that Ukrainian forces struck three Russian ballistic missile launchers on the night of 19-20 November, when Russia launched a large-scale attack on Ukraine.

items.title: Energieministerium: Leistung der Reaktoren nach russischen Angriffen muss teilweise gedrosselt werden
items.teaser: Nach massiven russischen Luftangriffen in der Nacht auf den 20. November mussten die Reaktoren gedrosselt werden. Die ukrainischen Kernkraftwerke können die Stromproduktion schrittweise wiederaufnehmen, nachdem die beschädigte Ausrüstung wieder instandgesetzt worden ist.

items.title: General Staff confirms three oil tanks hit at pumping station in Russia’s Tatarstan
items.teaser: On November 19, the Defense Forces of Ukraine struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station near Almetyevsk in Russia’s Republic of Tatarstan, a key hub of the Druzhba oil pipeline. Three large oil storage tanks have been confirmed hit.

items.title: Acht Tote bei neuen russischen Angriffen auf die Ukraine
items.teaser: Nach den spektakulären Angriffen auf die Krim-Brücke hatte Russlands Präsident Putin der Ukraine mit massiver Vergeltung gedroht. Nun nahm die russische Armee ihrerseits Brücken in Kyjiw ins Visier.

items.title: Russian attack forces nuclear power plants to reduce output - Energy Ministry
items.teaser: Ukraine's nuclear power plants were forced to reduce electricity generation following a large-scale Russian attack overnight and on the morning of November 20. A gradual return to normal operations will be possible once damaged power networks are restored.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit three Russian ballistic missile launchers – Zelensky
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said that the Defense Forces hit three Russian ballistic missile launchers overnight. One was destroyed, while the results of the strikes on the other two are still being assessed.

items.title: Wissenschaftliche:r Mitarbeiter:in (w/m/d) im Öffentlichen Recht am Standort Düsseldorf der BSP (65%)
items.teaser: The post Wissenschaftliche:r Mitarbeiter:in (w/m/d) im Öffentlichen Recht am Standort Düsseldorf der BSP (65%) appeared first on Völkerrechtsblog .

items.title: Women account for 60% of new individual entrepreneur registrations in Ukraine this year – Opendatabot
items.teaser: Women registered 148,470 individual entrepreneur entities in Ukraine in January-October 2026, accounting for 60% of all new registrations during the period.

items.title: Luftwaffe wehrt 82 russische Raketen und 380 Drohnen ab
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge 82 Raketen und 380 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine in der Nacht auf den 20. November angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: Two Russian missiles, jet-powered drone crash in Poland – Defense Minister
items.teaser: Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said that two Russian missiles and a drone crashed on Polish territory overnight into Friday, November 20, as Moscow launched a massive attack on Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian elite 'Rubicon' drone unit deployment site in Russian Kursk Oblast
items.teaser: The Rubicon Center for Advanced Unmanned Technologies is a sprawling Russian drone unit and the core of Russia's recently formed Unmanned Systems branch of the military.

items.title: Russian forces attack Sumy region, injuring woman and sparking massive fire
items.teaser: Russian drones struck residential buildings in the Nova Sloboda community in the Konotop district and the Hlukhiv community in the Shostka district of the Sumy region.

items.title: Merz, Koretskyi open German-Ukrainian Business Forum in Berlin
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi opened the ninth German-Ukrainian Business Forum in Berlin on Friday, with discussions focused on investment, strategic industries and Ukraine's reconstruction.

items.title: Ukraine cooperating with Poland in probe into airspace violation – FM Sybiha
items.teaser: Ukraine is working closely with Poland to assist in investigating the violation of Polish airspace during Russia's massive attack.

items.title: Illegal fuel depot with UAH 10M worth of counterfeit petrol and diesel uncovered in Kyiv
items.teaser: An illegal fuel depot where A-95 petrol and diesel fuel were produced for sale through filling stations in Kyiv and other regions has been uncovered in the Ukrainian capital. Assets seized during the operation are valued at about UAH 10 million.

items.title: Russian strikes damage Ukrenergo substations, emergency outages imposed in two regions
items.teaser: Russian attacks have caused significant damage to Ukraine's energy infrastructure, including substations belonging to NPC Ukrenergo. Emergency power outages have been imposed in the Poltava and Kharkiv regions as a result.

items.title: Smolensk’s Dorogobuzh nitrogen plant hit again as Ukraine’s drones work down Russia’s explosives supply chain
items.teaser: The plant sits near the start of the chain that ends in Russian munitions, and the same site keeps turning up on Ukraine’s target list.

items.title: Poland investigating crash of unidentified object near border during Russian attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: Polish military authorities are investigating two incidents involving possible violations of the country's airspace during Russia's massive attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20.

items.title: Chemiewerk im russischen Smolensk brennt nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: Drohnen haben in der Nacht ein Chemiewerk in der russischen Oblast Smolensk angegriffen, wie der Telegram- Kanal Astra berichtet.

items.title: Russian drone warhead removed from central Kyiv building: risk to all five storeys – photo, video
items.teaser: Experts took the barrel-shaped device to a disposal site after warning that a blast could have destroyed the five-storey apartment building.

items.title: Destinus: Firma in Hengelo feiert Angriff auf Krim-Brücke – Experten warnen
items.teaser: Der niederländische Konzern Destinus feiert den Einsatz seiner Drohne beim Angriff auf die Krim-Brücke. Kurz darauf wird die Botschaft des Landes in Kiew von Drohnenteilen getroffen. Experten sind alarmiert und fürchten Sabotageakte.

items.title: Ukraine’s air defenses down 82 missiles, 380 Russian drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defenses neutralized 82 missiles and 380 drones launched by Russian forces in an attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20. Russian strikes were recorded at 23 locations.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Kyiv targeted by missile strikes, bridges hit
items.teaser: Ukraine's capital has been struck by Russian missiles with at least 3 deaths reported. The latest strikes come after Vladimir Putin warned of a "painful" response following the Kerch bridge strikes. Follow DW.

items.title: Russian attack damages the central building of Mykhailo Drahomanov University in Kyiv
items.teaser: The central building of the Mykhailo Drahomanov Ukrainian State University was damaged as a result of a Russian attack on Kyiv on 19 November. Forty windows were shattered.

items.title: Hungary lifts veto on initial decision on the opening of negotiating clusters 4 and 5 for Ukraine
items.teaser: The Committee of Permanent Representatives (Coreper) approved the screening results of Ukrainian legislation under negotiating clusters 4 and 5 on Friday 20 November. This decision allows progress to the next stage of the procedure for their official opening within the framework of Ukraine's EU accession talks.

items.title: Opferzahl nach russischem kombiniertem Angriff auf Kyjiw steigt auf sechs Tote, 15 weitere Menschen verletzt
items.teaser: Nach einem nächtlichen russischen Angriff in Kyjiw ist die Zahl der Todesopfer auf sechs gestiegen, sagte die Sprecherin der Militärverwaltung der ukrainischen Haupstadt, Kateryna Pop, im Fernsehen.

items.title: Government directs additional UAH 81.4 bln to urgent Defense Ministry needs
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has allocated an additional UAH 81.4 billion for the urgent needs of Ukraine's Ministry of Defense.

items.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Kyiv rises to six, 15 injured
items.teaser: The death toll from Russia's overnight attack on Kyiv has risen to six.

items.title: Tote bei russischen Angriffen auf mehrere Brücken in Kiew
items.teaser: Es ist eine Attacke ins Herz der ukrainischen Hauptstadt: Russland hat in Kiew erneut Brücken beschossen und beschädigt. Mehrere Menschen wurden getötet. In Polen musste wegen des Angriffs zeitweise ein Flughafen den Betrieb einstellen.

items.title: Ukraine approves methodology for identifying strategic and critical mineral resources
items.teaser: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers has approved a methodology developed by the Ministry of Economy and Environment for identifying mineral resources of strategic and critical importance.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 278 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, die intensivsten - bei Pokrowsk
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 278 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russia calls US ideas for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine "unacceptable"
items.teaser: Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov insisted the Kremlin demands acknowledgment that Ukraine will not join the Alliance before any talks on future terms.

items.title: Russia attacks energy facility in Odesa Oblast: 41,000 households without power

items.title: Zelenskyy: Europeans to take part in negotiation formats with Russians
items.teaser: After talks with Western partners, Kyiv and Paris confirmed that five nations, the EU and NATO will represent the continent at the table alongside Washington.

items.title: Russia destroys 420 UOC churches, kills 25 priests since start of full-scale invasion
items.teaser: During the invasion, Russian troops have destroyed 420 churches belonging to the Ukrainian Orthodox Church (UOC), killed 25 of its priests, and sentenced clergy members who refused to submit to Patriarch Kirill.

items.title: Kathedrale und zwei Botschaften in Kyjiw bei russischem Angriff beschädigt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw am 19. November sind die Fenster der Wladimirkathedrale beschädigt worden.

items.title: Facing charges, SBU general goes all-in against anti-graft agencies investigating him
items.teaser: Days after his release from pre-trial detention, SBU Major General Serhiy Duka went on the offensive against the anti-corruption agencies responsible for his arrest. Arriving at the Kyiv City Council flanked by three men in military attire whom he introduced as his "bodyguards," Duka spent more than three

items.title: EU ambassador to Ukraine recounts downing of Russian drone overhead
items.teaser: The bloc's envoy and a colleague were rushed inside a hotel by security after an aerial target was destroyed nearby during a day of attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

items.title: Austrian Embassy in Kyiv damaged in Russian attack
items.teaser: The Embassy of Austria in Ukraine was damaged during a Russian drone attack on Kyiv.

items.title: Ukraine-Hilfen: Ergebnisse des Treffens der "Koalition der Willigen"
items.teaser: Pressekonferenz nach dem Treffen der "Koalition der Willigen" im Kanzleramt

items.title: Russian drone attacks enterprise in Kremenchuk
items.teaser: A Russian drone has struck an industrial facility in the city of Kremenchuk in Poltava Oblast.

items.title: Austrian foreign minister shares details of Kyiv embassy damage after Russian attack
items.teaser: Austria's top diplomat confirmed all mission personnel are unharmed and praised their commitment under hazardous conditions during Moscow's aerial assault on the Ukrainian capital

items.title: Zelensky outlines key topics for Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said that the key topics at today’s Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin include covering Ukraine’s budget needs, strengthening air defense, and a winter package of ballistic missile interceptors.

items.title: Trump says Putin upset with Zelenskyy over Kerch Bridge attack
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has told a journalist after the summit in China that Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin was upset with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy over the attack on the Kerch Bridge.

items.title: Russian forces trying to advance toward Orikhiv in small infantry groups but fail – military
items.teaser: Russian forces continue trying to advance toward Orikhiv in the Zaporizhzhia region, using small infantry groups to infiltrate Ukrainian positions. However, the Defense Forces detect and destroy the enemy in time, before they can reach the city, which remains under the control of Ukrainian defenders.

items.title: Russians strike Kharkiv: five injured, shops damaged
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Kharkiv with drones in the early evening of 19 November, with a strike recorded in the Saltivskyi district and five people reported injured.

items.title: Trümmer russischer Drohne stürzen auf dem Gelände des Außenministeriums in Kyjiw ab
items.teaser: Infolge eines russischen Drohnenangriffs auf Kyjiw sind Drohnentrümmer auf dem Gelände des Auswärtigen Amts der Ukraine abgestürzt, teilt der Außenminister, Anrdij Sybiha, auf X mit.

items.title: Russian attack damages St Volodymyr's Cathedral in Kyiv
items.teaser: Wreckage from an aerial attack broke window panes at the 19th-century landmark, a nearby diplomatic mission and more than 10 cars in central Kyiv.

items.title: Third strike on Kerch Bridge in a week: Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit railway link to occupied Crimea
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces hit the railway section of the bridge built by Russia to connect its territory with occupied Crimea. The strike halted train traffic and further disrupted a key route supplying Russian forces.

items.title: “Shenzhen is not the Yalta of Putin's dreams,” FM Sybiha says
items.teaser: The meeting of the leaders of China, the United States and Russia in Shenzhen, China, failed to fulfill Putin’s hopes of returning to the era of the Yalta Conference. It is time for him to face reality and end the war against Ukraine, which he cannot win.

items.title: Exclusive: Ukrainian authorities agree on landmark bill regulating crypto market
items.teaser: International partners have steadily put pressure on Ukraine to move forward with regulating digital assets as part of its commitments to both the EU and the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

items.title: Freelance Commercial Content Writer
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent, Ukraine’s main English-language publication, is looking for a Freelance Commercial Content Writer.

items.title: Zelenskyy meets leaders of Germany, UK and France in Berlin
items.teaser: Discussions ahead of the Coalition of the Willing gathering focused on protecting Ukraine's energy grid, countering Russian strikes and coordinating allied security guarantees.

items.title: The Kerch Bridge span fell without Starlink, a Ukrainian officer says. Only weeks earlier Kyiv was asking Washington for Starshield to strike deep, Rubio said
items.teaser: Drones passed video to missiles so they could strike exact points on the bridge, “for the first time in history,” an officer involved in the strike told The Times.

items.title: Russia's newest strike drones still depend on Western technology
items.teaser: With years of sanctions and regulations from the West, Russia has learned to replace Western components in its weapons with Chinese alternatives. Even Russia's Geran-2 strike drones, which historically relied heavily on Western components, now increasingly include Chinese equivalents that can be supplied without the gr

items.title: Open-source analyst shows satellite images of Kerch Bridge after Neptune attack
items.teaser: New visuals mark impact points on both the road and rail sections of the crossing linking occupied Crimea with Russia in overnight strikes.

items.title: No cause for concern about Ukraine’s food security, minister says
items.teaser: The Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food currently sees no risks to food security on the domestic market.

items.title: Russischer Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw: ein Mensch getötet, vier weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Bei einer neuen Welle von russischen Drohnenangriffen auf Kyjiw ist ein Mensch getötet worden. Vier weitere Menschen wurden verletzt.

items.title: One killed, five injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv, St. Volodymyr’s Cathedral damaged
items.teaser: One person was killed and five others injured in a Russian drone attack on Kyiv. Windows at St. Volodymyr’s Cathedral were also damaged.

items.title: Hungary lifts block on further progress for Ukraine, Moldova EU membership bids
items.teaser: Hungary had been delaying the final approval needed to unlock the two so-called enlargement clusters, but without explicitly stating a reason.

items.title: Russian drone debris falls on Ukraine's Foreign Ministry grounds in Kyiv - photos
items.teaser: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha says the fragments will be added to the ministry's museum and sends a defiant message to Moscow after strikes near diplomatic sites.

items.title: Putin comments on strikes on Kerch bridge for first time
items.teaser: Russian ruler Vladimir Putin has commented for the first time on the strikes on the Kerch Bridge, saying that Russia will no longer negotiate an “energy truce” with Ukraine following the attacks.

items.title: NATO secretary general calls Trump, Putin and Xi meeting "normal"
items.teaser: The Alliance's head praised Donald Trump's efforts to end the war in Ukraine and stressed the importance of dialogue among major nuclear states during the historic talks.

items.title: Frau in Region Kyjiw bei russischem Angriff getötet, es gibt zwei Verletzte
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff im Bezirk Butscha in der Region Kyjiw ist eine Frau ums Leben gekommen. Ein weiterer Mann wurde verletzt.

items.title: Masala: Trumps Truppenaufmarsch bringt USA in Zwangslage
items.teaser: In Washington wächst die Angst vor iranischen Anschlägen. Einen solchen Angriff hält Militärexperte Masala für „erstmal ausgeschlossen“, warnt jedoch vor einer gefährlichen Zwangslage in Nahost.

items.title: Putin sets condition for European involvement in talks on war in Ukraine
items.teaser: Russian ruler Vladimir Putin has said the Kremlin is ready to include European representatives in negotiations on Ukraine, but only after they come to Moscow to discuss their proposals.

items.title: Russian attack kills one person in Kyiv
items.teaser: UAV attacks continue across the Ukrainian capital as authorities report falling wreckage in multiple districts and a strike on a building behind the Dutch Embassy.

items.title: UNESCO condemns Russian attack on historic centre of Odesa
items.teaser: UNESCO warns that attacks on protected cultural and educational sites deprive communities of shared spaces needed for recovery, and offers help assessing damage in Odesa.

items.title: A Russian handler courted a Colombian ex-soldier from a Kyiv teen’s account and arranged the date, police say. Then the teen allegedly poured the poison for a promised $1,000, filmed him dying, and fled
items.teaser: The Colombian had left Ukraine’s army when his contract ended months earlier. Investigators are still identifying who ordered his killing.

items.title: Russian aircraft strike hits Myrne in Donetsk region, injuring elderly couple
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out an airstrike on the settlement of Myrne in the Sloviansk community of the Donetsk region, injuring an elderly couple.

items.title: Russian drone damages Dutch Embassy building in Kyiv during attack – photo
items.teaser: During the Russian attack on Kyiv on 19 November, one of the drones struck a building located behind the Dutch Embassy.

items.title: Russians attack Kyiv Oblast again: man injured, houses damaged
items.teaser: Emergency medics were dispatched after a man suffered leg injuries in the Brovary district, while four homes were damaged in the Fastiv district during renewed attacks on 19 November.

items.title: 21 Verletzte bei russischem Angriff auf Isjum, darunter vier KInder
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff auf ein Mehrfamilienwohnhaus in Isjum in der Region Charkiw sind 21 Personen verletzt worden, darunter vier Kinder, teilt die regionale Polizei auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Woman killed, several injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv region
items.teaser: A woman was killed and a man injured in a Russian drone attack in the Bucha district of the Kyiv region.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian strike on Izium rises to 21, including four children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian strike on an apartment building in Izium, Kharkiv region, has risen to 21, including four children.

items.title: Wadephul: 'Coalition of the Willing' talks in Berlin send strong signal to Moscow
items.teaser: German Foreign Minister Wadephul has said the Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin sends a clear message to Moscow to take peace talks seriously. He also warned Ukraine should be prepared for peace talks to fail.

items.title: Selenskyj in Berlin eingetroffen
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj ist zu einem Gipfeltreffen der sogenannten Koalition der Willigen in Berlin eingetroffen, teilt der Ukrinform- Korrespondent mit.

items.title: Drone debris falls near three-story building in Kyiv’s Podilskyi district
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian drone has been reported near a three-story building in Kyiv’s Podilskyi district.

items.title: Liveticker zu Gipfeln: ++ Kushner und Witkoff in Berlin angekommen ++
items.teaser: Die US-Unterhändler Kushner und Witkoff sind zum Ukraine-Gipfel in Berlin eingetroffen. Russland ist laut Präsident Putin zu Gesprächen mit Europäern über den Krieg gegen die Ukraine bereit.

items.title: Generalstaatsanwaltschaft Düsseldorf - Vorwurf: Schüler soll Terroranschlag auf Moschee mit Waffen aus 3-D-Drucker geplant haben
items.teaser: Ein vermutlich rechtsradikaler Schüler aus dem sauerländischen Eslohe soll einen Anschlag auf eine Moschee mit Waffen aus einem 3-D-Drucker geplant haben.

items.title: Generalstab bestätigt Beschädigung des Bahnteils der Krim- Brücke
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Armee hat in der Nacht zum Donnerstag erneut die Krimbrücke mit Neptun- Raketen angegriffen. Der Eisenbahnabschnitt ist beschädigt worden, teilt der der Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Markus Preiß, ARD Berlin, über das Treffen der "Koalition der Willigen" zum Ukraine-Gipfel in Berlin
items.teaser: Markus Preiß, ARD Berlin, über das Treffen der "Koalition der Willigen" zum Ukraine-Gipfel in Berlin

items.title: Witkoff, Kushner arrive in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing summit
items.teaser: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived at the German Federal Chancellery in Berlin for talks with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and to attend the Coalition of the Willing summit.

items.title: Breaking: Dutch Embassy damaged in Russian drone strike on Kyiv
items.teaser: It is not clear if the drone was targeting the area in which the Dutch Embassy is located or if it was shot down.

items.title: APEC summit: Trump, Xi, Putin talks end with 'peace declaration'
items.teaser: The three world leaders discussed the Russian invasion of Ukraine as well as nuclear arms controls. Following the trilateral talks, President Trump reportedly headed to the airport. Follow DW live.

items.title: Russia to launch passenger boats across Kerch Strait after Ukrainian strikes on Crimean Bridge
items.teaser: Russian occupation authorities plan to run free passenger-only boats between Port Krym and Port Kavkaz from 20 November after strikes damaged the bridge.

items.title: Chinese, US, Russian leaders adopt 'peace declaration,' make no mention of Ukraine
items.teaser: The leaders of China, the United States and Russia have adopted a joint "peace declaration" at a trilateral summit, making no mention of Russia's war against Ukraine or the operation against Iran.

items.title: Notstromabschaltungen in fünf Regionen infolge russischer Angriffe
items.teaser: Nach dem russischen Drohnen- und Raketenangriff wurden am Donnerstag, dem 19. November, in fünf Regionen der Ukraine Stromausfälle gemeldet.

items.title: Russian strike destroys section of residential building in Izium, injures 16
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck a residential building in Izium, Kharkiv region.

items.title: Putin vows to rebuild the Crimean Bridge and threatens Ukraine with a "far more painful" response
items.teaser: Russian leader Vladimir Putin rules out negotiations over the Crimean Bridge attacks, vows to restore the crossing and threatens severe retaliation after overnight Neptune strikes hit its railway section.

items.title: Gambia v. Myanmar: The Bottom Line
items.teaser: The ICJ just delivered its historic judgment in Gambia v. Myanmar. By 9 votes to 6, it found that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya. It also made a number of other findings, which I will not discuss here. As a matter of remedies, the Court ordered Myanmar to institute a programme of restitution and compen

items.title: UK to provide Ukraine with more than 1,000 long-range drones
items.teaser: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will announce a new GBP 260 million (more than $342 million) military aid package for Ukraine on Thursday after arriving in Berlin for the Coalition of the Willing summit. The package includes long-range drones.

items.title: Neptune missile strike damages railway track on Crimean Bridge -- General Staff
items.teaser: The General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces has confirmed that Ukrainian Neptune missiles damaged the railway track on the Kerch Strait Bridge overnight on November 19.

items.title: Zelensky arrives in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing meeting
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in Berlin to take part in a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing.

items.title: Trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi and Putin held in Shenzhen
items.teaser: A trilateral meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian ruler Vladimir Putin took place on Thursday on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China. According to the leaders, they discussed the war in Ukraine and nuclear arms control.

items.title: He refused to abandon his birds: Birdkeeper and 600 pigeons evacuate from Kramatorsk – video
items.teaser: A 70-year-old Kramatorsk resident who refused to leave his 600 pigeons behind has been evacuated with volunteers from Animal Rescue Kharkiv, who crated the birds in about two hours and moved them to safety.

items.title: Zelenskyy arrives in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing meeting – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrives in Berlin on 19 November for Coalition of the Willing talks with over 40 partners, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, European national security advisers and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.

items.title: Französische Soldaten in der Ukraine - aber nicht zum Kampf
items.teaser: Russland wirft Frankreich vor, sich mit Soldaten in der Ukraine direkt am Krieg zu beteiligen. Die französische Regierung weist das zurück, bestätigt aber die Anwesenheit von Militärpersonal. Was ist ihre Aufgabe? Von C. Rienäcker.

items.title: Zelensky arrives in Berlin for talks with European officials, Trump's envoys
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky outlined four priorities for Ukraine at the Coalition of the Willing meeting, including air defense, energy and financial support, diplomacy, and efforts to end Russia's war.

items.title: Russian forces strike residential building in Izium, two injured
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck a residential building in Izium, Kharkiv region. Two people have been reported injured, and others may be trapped under the rubble.

items.title: Russia attacks Naftogaz gas workers for third time in days, leaving one injured – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked gas workers from the Naftogaz Group for the third time this week. This time, a driver from an emergency response crew was injured in Chuhuiv, Kharkiv Oblast.

items.title: Krim-Brücke nach ukrainischem Angriff erneut gesperrt
items.teaser: Nach einem erneuten Angriff auf die für Russland strategisch wichtige Krim-Brücke ist laut Behörden nun der Zugverkehr "vorübergehend" eingestellt worden. Zuvor hatte eine Attacke bereits den Autoverkehr lahmgelegt.

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin approve a joint peace declaration without mentioning Ukraine
items.teaser: Xinhua publishes a joint statement from Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin covering nuclear non-proliferation, energy supply, UN reform and official immunity, but leaving out any provisions on the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Treffen der „Koalition der Willigen“ in Berlin mit Selenskyj und US-Vertretern
items.teaser: In der deutschen Hauptstadt Berlin beginnt der Gipfel der „Koalition der Willigen“.

items.title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Mykolaiv region, one injured
items.teaser: One person was injured and a warehouse was damaged when Russian forces attacked an industrial facility in the city of Voznesensk, Mykolaiv region, on the morning of November 19.

items.title: Ukraine to receive over 1,000 long-range strike drones from UK
items.teaser: The UK will provide Ukraine with over 1,000 long-range strike drones capable of flying more than 1,000 km as part of a new £260 million military aid package.

items.title: Railway track of Crimean Bridge damaged by Neptunes
items.teaser: Ukraine's military have reported hits on the railway track and arch area of the Crimean Bridge overnight on 19 November alongside confirmed damage to three other Russian supply bridges in Luhansk and Rostov oblasts.

items.title: Russian drone hits office building in Kyiv's Podilskyi district
items.teaser: A Russian drone has struck a three-story office building in Kyiv's Podilskyi district.

items.title: The world’s new big three has a seat for Moscow and none for Europe
items.teaser: Beijing frames the Shenzhen summit as a meeting about world peace, but it gives Putin the great-power status he has been fighting for since 2022.
